crossRefs.note: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one…
In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the…
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into…

translations.web: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
translations.bsb: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
translations.kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
translations.asv: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
